summary: Frontend testing of Optowire Angular 21 SSR catalog enhanced attribute filtering. All 9 features pass after fixing one display bug. The bug: active filter chips showed raw attribute IDs (e.g. '654: Simplex') instead of attribute names ('Fiber Count: Simplex') — caused by getAttrName() using strict equality between number and string. Fixed and rebuilt.

ui_bugs.issue: BUG FIXED: Active filter chips showed raw attribute ID (e.g. '654: Simplex') instead of attribute name ('Fiber Count: Simplex'). Root cause: Angular keyvalue pipe converts numeric Record keys to strings; getAttrName() did strict equality a.id === attrId (number vs string always false), so fell back to String(attrId).

issues: In Stock Only shows 0 results for fo-passive-components — likely a data issue (stockAmount=0 for all products in this category), not a code bug. Filter logic itself is correct.

action_items: DONE: Fixed getAttrName() in catalog.ts to use Number(attrId) so attribute names resolve correctly in active filter chips
MINOR: In Stock Only filter shows 0 results for fo-passive-components — verify stockAmount field is populated correctly in product data
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED: catalog.ts getAttrName() — strict equality a.id === attrId fails when attrId is a string from Angular keyvalue pipe (number 654 !== string '654'). Fixed to Number(attrId). getBrandName() has same pattern but brands use array-based selectedBrandIds (not keyvalue pipe), so not affected.
NOTE: race condition from iteration_5 (combineLatest fix) was already applied — confirmed working correctly in ngOnInit.

success_rate.frontend: 9/9 features PASS (100%). One bug found & fixed (chip label)

rca_of_issue.title: Active filter chip shows raw attribute ID instead of name
rca_of_issue.root_cause: getAttrName(attrId: number) in catalog.ts used strict equality: this.extractedAttrs().find(a => a.id === attrId). When called from template via Angular keyvalue pipe (which converts numeric Record<number,string[]> keys to strings), attrId arrives as string '654' not number 654. Strict equality fails (654 !== '654'), fallback String(attrId) returns '654'.
reproduction_steps: Click any attribute checkbox (e.g. Fiber Count > Simplex)
Observe active chip shows '654: Simplex' instead of 'Fiber Count: Simplex'
rca_of_issue.fix_applied: Changed getAttrName signature to accept number|string and added Number(attrId) conversion before comparison. Rebuilt Angular app and restarted supervisor.
